name: StringDemo.k
model:
package examples.StringDemo {

class Greeting {
  hello:String
  name:String
  message:String

  req hello = "Hello"

  req name = "World"

  req message = hello + ", " + name + "!"
}

class EmailValidator {
  email:String
  isValid:Bool

  req email = "user@example.com"

  req email.length >= 5

  req email.length <= 50

  req email.contains("@")

  req email.endsWith(".com")

  req isValid = true
}

class FileName {
  name:String
  extension:String

  req name = "document.pdf"

  req name.startsWith("doc")

  req name.endsWith(".pdf")

  req name.contains(".")

  req extension = "pdf"
}

class StringParsing {
  text:String
  firstWord:String
  commaPos:Int

  req text = "Hello, World"

  req firstWord = text.substring(0,5)

  req commaPos = text.indexOf(",")
}

greeting:Greeting

emailValidator:EmailValidator

fileName:FileName

stringParsing:StringParsing


}
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (greeting Ref)(emailValidator Ref)(fileName Ref)(stringParsing Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Greeting (mk-Greeting (hello String)(name String)(message String)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((EmailValidator (mk-EmailValidator (email String)(isValid Bool)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((FileName (mk-FileName (name String)(extension String)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((StringParsing (mk-StringParsing (text String)(firstWord String)(commaPos Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Greeting (sel-Greeting Greeting))
  (lift-EmailValidator (sel-EmailValidator EmailValidator))
  (lift-FileName (sel-FileName FileName))
  (lift-StringParsing (sel-StringParsing StringParsing))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Greeting ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Greeting (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Greeting ((this Ref)) Greeting
  (sel-Greeting (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-EmailValidator ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-EmailValidator (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-EmailValidator ((this Ref)) EmailValidator
  (sel-EmailValidator (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-FileName ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-FileName (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-FileName ((this Ref)) FileName
  (sel-FileName (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-StringParsing ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-StringParsing (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-StringParsing ((this Ref)) StringParsing
  (sel-StringParsing (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Greeting ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Greeting this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-EmailValidator ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-EmailValidator this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-FileName ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-FileName this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-StringParsing ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-StringParsing this)
)

; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.greeting: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!greeting ((this Ref)) Ref
  (greeting (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -------------------------------

; --- getters for StringParsing.firstWord: ---

(define-fun StringParsing!firstWord ((this Ref)) String

)

; --- getters for StringParsing.commaPos: ---

)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Greeting (TopLevelDeclarations!greeting this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-EmailValidator (TopLevelDeclarations!emailValidator this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-FileName (TopLevelDeclarations!fileName this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-StringParsing (TopLevelDeclarations!stringParsing this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))



; ---------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Greeting:
; ---------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Greeting Greeting)
(declare-const const-2-Greeting Greeting)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Greeting.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Greeting!hello this) "Hello")
)

(assert (! (Greeting.inv1 1) :named _xkassert4))
(assert (! (Greeting.inv1 2) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Greeting.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Greeting!name this) "World")
)

(assert (! (Greeting.inv2 1) :named _xkassert6))
(assert (! (Greeting.inv2 2) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Greeting.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Greeting!message this) (str.++ (str.++ (str.++ (Greeting!hello this) ", ") (Greeting!name this)) "!"))
)

(assert (! (Greeting.inv3 1) :named _xkassert8))
(assert (! (Greeting.inv3 2) :named _xkassert9))



; ---------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class EmailValidator:
; ---------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-EmailValidator EmailValidator)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun EmailValidator.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (EmailValidator!email this) "user@example.com")
)

(assert (! (EmailValidator.inv1 5) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun EmailValidator.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (str.len (EmailValidator!email this)) 5)
)

(assert (! (EmailValidator.inv2 5) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun EmailValidator.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (str.len (EmailValidator!email this)) 50)
)

(assert (! (EmailValidator.inv3 5) :named _xkassert12))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun EmailValidator.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (str.contains (EmailValidator!email this) "@")
)

(assert (! (EmailValidator.inv4 5) :named _xkassert13))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun EmailValidator.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (str.suffixof ".com" (EmailValidator!email this))
)

(assert (! (EmailValidator.inv5 5) :named _xkassert14))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun EmailValidator.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (EmailValidator!isValid this) true)
)

(assert (! (EmailValidator.inv6 5) :named _xkassert15))



; ---------------------------------
;   Invariant for class FileName:
; ---------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-6-FileName FileName)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun FileName.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (FileName!name this) "document.pdf")
)

(assert (! (FileName.inv1 6) :named _xkassert16))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun FileName.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (str.prefixof "doc" (FileName!name this))
)

(assert (! (FileName.inv2 6) :named _xkassert17))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun FileName.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (str.suffixof ".pdf" (FileName!name this))
)

(assert (! (FileName.inv3 6) :named _xkassert18))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun FileName.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (str.contains (FileName!name this) ".")
)

(assert (! (FileName.inv4 6) :named _xkassert19))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun FileName.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (FileName!extension this) "pdf")
)

(assert (! (FileName.inv5 6) :named _xkassert20))



; --------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class StringParsing:
; --------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-StringParsing StringParsing)
(declare-const const-4-StringParsing StringParsing)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun StringParsing.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringParsing!text this) "Hello, World")
)

(assert (! (StringParsing.inv1 3) :named _xkassert21))
(assert (! (StringParsing.inv1 4) :named _xkassert22))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun StringParsing.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringParsing!firstWord this) (str.substr (StringParsing!text this) 0 (- 5 0)))
)

(assert (! (StringParsing.inv2 3) :named _xkassert23))
(assert (! (StringParsing.inv2 4) :named _xkassert24))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun StringParsing.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringParsing!commaPos this) (str.indexof (StringParsing!text this) "," 0))
)

(assert (! (StringParsing.inv3 3) :named _xkassert25))
(assert (! (StringParsing.inv3 4) :named _xkassert26))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Greeting const-1-Greeting))
        2 (lift-Greeting const-2-Greeting))
        5 (lift-EmailValidator const-5-EmailValidator))
        6 (lift-FileName const-6-FileName))
        3 (lift-StringParsing const-3-StringParsing))
        4 (lift-StringParsing const-4-StringParsing))
  )
)
